heading: Definitions
lead: As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

tree.text: The term “Board” means the Climate Program Policy Board.
The term “Office” means the National Climate Program Office.
The term “Program” means the National Climate Program.
The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Commerce.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1986—Pub. L. 99–272 added par. (1) and redesignated former pars. (1) to (3) as (2) to (4), respectively.
